column1: # Image build catalog used by bin/fredlab-build.
# name: short command name used as `bin/fredlab-build <name> <tag>`
# image: Artifact Registry image name under fredlab-repo
# repo_dir: local source repository root. Use `$FRED_REPO_DIR` for the Fred monorepo
#           (resolves to the FRED_REPO_DIR env, default ~/fred — the SAME single knob
#           fredlab-release.sh uses for the tag). Only other repos get a literal path.
# build_context: Docker build context from repo_dir, usually `.`
